# MIX-SMM.RU — Complete SMM Platform Guide

> MIX-SMM.RU is an automated SMM panel for ordering social media promotion services: followers, likes, views, comments for Telegram, VK, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Discord, Twitch, Spotify. Operating since 2024. 5,600+ users, 1,847,000+ orders completed.

## Platform Statistics

- **5,600+** registered users
- **1,847,000+** orders completed
- **1,063+** available services
- **0.4₽** minimum price per 1,000
- **~34 seconds** between new orders
- **24/7** automated processing

## Key Sections

### Quick Start
Registration → Top-up balance → Choose service → Place order → Track status → Result (5 minutes)

### Service Catalog
1,000+ services across platforms:
- **Telegram:** Subscribers, Views, Reactions, Comments, Post Views, Channel Members
- **VK:** Subscribers, Likes, Views, Reposts, Comments, Friends
- **YouTube:** Subscribers, Views, Likes, Comments, Watch Hours
- **TikTok:** Followers, Likes, Views, Shares
- **Instagram:** Followers, Likes, Views, Story Views
- **Discord:** Members, Boosts
- **Twitch:** Viewers, Followers
- **Spotify:** Plays, Followers
- **Other:** Yandex Music, RuTube, Likee, SoundCloud

### Order Management
- Statuses: Pending, In Progress, Completed, Partial, Cancelled
- Cancellation rules and refund policy
- Drip-feed for gradual delivery
- Mass orders for bulk promotion

### Telegram Aged Objects
- Buy Telegram channels/chats with verified age (6mo, 10mo, 1yr+)
- Partner service: [targetlike.com](https://targetlike.com)
- Verified creation dates, instant transfer, 24h guarantee

### API v2
- Full programmatic access
- Standard SMM API v2 compatible
- Endpoints: services, add, status, balance
- Documentation: https://mix-smm.ru/api

### Child Panel
- White-label SMM service under your own brand
- Price: 2,500 ₽/month
- Full control, your domain, your pricing

### Referral Program
- Earn percentage from referred users' orders
- Automatic, unlimited, indefinite
- No limits on referrals

### Pro Strategies
- Aged object + promotion bundle
- Budget optimization tips
- Mass order automation
- Drip-feed for organic growth

## Pricing

- Minimum order: from 0.4₽ per 1,000
- Top-up bonuses: +3% (from 3,000₽), +7% (from 50,000₽)
- Payment methods: Russian bank cards, e-wallets, cryptocurrency
- Automatic processing 24/7

## Platforms Supported

Telegram, VK (ВКонтакте), YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Discord, Twitch, Spotify, Yandex Music, RuTube, Likee, SoundCloud

## Services Include

Subscribers, Likes, Views, Reposts, Comments, Reactions, Story Views, Stream Viewers, Auto-services (auto-views, auto-reactions), Retention views, Friend requests, Channel members, Post saves, Shares
